name: cyber-defense-portfolio
description: Interactive 3D animated cybersecurity portfolio featuring WebGL defense core, live interactive terminal, vulnerability lab, MITRE ATT&CK intelligence, and production-ready architecture.
conventions: All components use named exports or clean modular exports
Zero generic AI slop: no purple gradients, no pill CTA buttons, no fake reviews/metrics
Preserve native OS cursor and accessible responsive layout
Full production essentials: custom metadata, favicon suite, /privacy and /terms pages
architecture_patterns: 3D WebGL scenes encapsulated with clean lifecycle management and cleanup
Client-side simulated terminal and cybersecurity intelligence modules

file_structure.src/data: Cybersecurity projects, skills, research, and CTF data
file_structure.public: Static assets including full favicon suite

never_do: Never use purple gradients, pill buttons, fake reviews/metrics/counters, vague hero text, emoji icons, em dashes, crazy scroll/cursor animations, or AI slop photos/copy on websites
Never let an AI grade its own work without independent gate verification
Never leave completed work uncommitted or unpushed to GitHub
Never run unsolicited background daemons, update pollers, or indexing services on Arch Linux
preferred_patterns: Practice extreme token economy: keep responses concise, high-signal, and directly answer user requests without unprompted changelogs or filler
Always mandate production web essentials: custom domain metadata, custom favicon suite, remove AI badges, /privacy page, and /terms page
Always enforce Arch Linux On-Demand System Governance (run interactive tools on-demand, terminate completely on exit)
